name: Thornburg Foundation
program: Initiatives (Water, Land, K-12 Education, Housing, Community Funding)
collect_note: No public call list exists: the Foundation says it does not accept unsolicited proposals. Its news page is watched twice a day and any change is flagged for review. No deadlines are collected. Not every news post is a funding announcement.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET (desktop UA, 30 s): https://www.thornburgfoundation.org/ 200 (105697 bytes); /grantees, /initiatives/community-funding, /initiatives/pursuing-public-funds 200 with the unsolicited-proposals sentence; /sitemap.xml 200 (no calls URLs: about, board, careers, financials, grantees, initiatives/*, news/*); /feed 200 returns HTML not a feed; /rss, /grants, /apply, /grant-opportunities 404; /wp-json/wp/v2/types 403. Checked 2026-11-12. Re-checked 2026-11-12: homepage, /initiatives/community-funding, /news, /grantees all carry 'The Thornburg Foundation does not accept unsolicited proposals'; no deadline or application wording found.
page_reason: Thornburg states on its homepage and initiative pages that it does not accept unsolicited proposals (contact info@thornburgfoundation.org if your work aligns with a current initiative), so there is no public call list, feed, API or labelled deadline. Grant rounds appear only as news posts without deadlines, so the news page is watched for a new announcement.
